rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a task or activity is very tiring.

example.jyutping: bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6

rows.note: Use this when the tiring activity also feels arduous, demanding, or hard to endure.

example.english: Caring for a sick person is exhausting.
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2
